summary: Wired Datasette startup through the ASGI lifespan. In datasette/app.py added self._setup_db_done and self._startup_lock (both init branches), plus a new idempotent, lock-guarded Datasette._startup_sequence() that runs the immutable-database table-count precompute once then invoke_startup(). Datasette.app() dropped its local setup_db and now wraps AsgiLifespan(on_startup=[_startup_sequence], on_shutdown=[_close_on_shutdown]) then AsgiRunOnFirstRequest(on_startup=[_startup_sequence]). In datasette/utils/asgi.py AsgiLifespan now catches hook exceptions and reports lifespan.startup.failed/shutdown.failed, and AsgiRunOnFirstRequest gained an asyncio.Lock, passes lifespan scopes straight through, and only sets _started after hooks finish. datasette/cli.py serve() calls ds._startup_sequence(). Check command passed: 157 passed, 4 skipped.
concerns: AsgiRunOnFirstRequest now returns early for lifespan scopes; confirm no wrapper ordering relies on it running hooks there.
AsgiLifespan returns after sending a failed message; verify uvicorn/lifespan hosts behave as tests expect.
_startup_lock is a single lock shared with no timeout; a hook that blocks forever will stall concurrent first requests.
